eventDetail.scope: MetroSea conference will be broad in scope covering all areas concerning research in measurements and instrumentation field. With the breadth of topics covered, this conference seeks to attract diverse participation and collaboration from academia, industry, and government agencies that will promote marine science and technologies interests with opportunities to increase technical depth and breadth as well as networking with peers. In a world where technology is rapidly changing, collaborations and multidisciplinary work is the only way to solve research challenges and foster the next generation of scientific discovery.
